programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ciberseguridad e Inteligencia de Datos
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Cybersecurity and Data Intelligence
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — no explicit 'idioma de impartición' statement located on the ULL programme pages; all official plan content (asignatura names, guías) is in Spanish and the programme is listed by the Canary Islands fee decree under its Spanish title. Treat as Spanish-taught but UNCONFIRMED. Do NOT infer from the English version of the ULL website.
language_requirement: B1 English required: 'para acceder a este máster será requisito indispensable la acreditación de un nivel B1 de inglés'. No Spanish certificate requirement found.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (Decreto 177/2022 prorrogado a 2023-24, 2024-25 y 2025-26; 2026-27/2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED)
non_eu_surcharge: No. Decreto 177/2022 (Canarias) sets one scale by grado de experimentalidad and matrícula number; it contains no article differentiating price by nationality or residency. Checked the full decree text (Arts. 1-20 + Anexos 1º y 2º) — nothing on 'no comunitarios' / 'no residentes'.
entry_requirements: Official Spanish/EHEA degree, or a non-EHEA degree the university verifies as equivalent (comprobación de equivalencia required before applying). Baremo: expediente académico (0-4), rama de la titulación (Informática/TIC = 3 pts; afines con experiencia profesional TIC = 2 pts; otras = 1 pt), CV (0-2). B1 English mandatory.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. Perfil de ingreso names 'Ingenierías del ámbito TIC, como Informática y Telecomunicaciones' and the admission baremo awards the top 3 points to Informática/TIC degrees. A Software Engineering degree scores in the top band.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 in the RUCT record. The ULL 'Acceso, admisión y matrícula' page states no complementos de formación for any applicant profile; none found at applicant level either.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND for this programme specifically. ULL has a general 'Reconocimiento y transferencia de créditos' regime linked from the programme's academic information menu but no figure or rule for a 300-ECTS entrant was published on the pages opened. The master is 60 ECTS of which 48 obligatorias + 6 prácticas + 6 TFM, leaving little recognisable material.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. For 2026-27 (ULL published calendar): admission documentation review 18-24 June 2026; matrícula new students 1st list 29-30 July 2026, 2nd list 4-5 August 2026; extraordinary call 25-27 August 2026 with matrícula lists 2 and 7 October 2026; single payment / first instalment due 17 September 2026 22:00.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — a non-EHEA degree holder must first complete ULL's 'comprobación de equivalencia de tu titulación' BEFORE the general application, which adds lead time. No separate earlier window exists, so start the equivalence check months ahead.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS, all obligatorias (48) + Prácticas Externas (6) + TFM (6). Two strands interleaved: cybersecurity (Identidad Digital, Seguridad de las Comunicaciones Inalámbricas, Seguridad de las Comunicaciones por Internet, Criptografía de Clave Secreta, Infraestructuras de Seguridad, Consultoría y Auditoría de Seguridad, Programación de Código Seguro, Hacking Ético y Análisis Forense) and data intelligence (Infraestructuras para Datos Masivos, Tecnologías para Datos Masivos, Adquisición e Integración de Datos, Extracción de Conocimiento en Bases de Datos, Preprocesado de Datos, Técnicas Avanzadas de Análisis de Datos, Visualización). Big-data infrastructure content gives it an AC (cloud/distributed) flavour alongside AB.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Coordinator Pino Teresa Caballero Gil (cryptography), Escuela Superior de Ingeniería y Tecnología (ESIT), ULL.
thesis_or_internship: Both: Prácticas Externas 6 ECTS + Trabajo Fin de Máster 6 ECTS.
conflicts: Plan-de-estudios page arithmetic: the ULL structure page lists 'Obligatorias 60 ECTS' plus Prácticas 6 + TFM 6 = 72, while RUCT records 48 obligatorias + 6 prácticas + 6 TFM = 60 total. RUCT (60 ECTS) is authoritative; the ULL page appears to double-count.
notes: COST ARITHMETIC (the decisive fact). Canarias fees come from DECRETO 177/2022 de 3 de agosto (BOC núm. 159, 11/08/2022, boc-a-2022-159-2660), whose application has been extended to 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. Anexo 1º tarifa 1.3 'Másteres no habilitantes', primera matrícula: grado de experimentalidad 1 = 15,15 EUR/crédito (2 = 14,06; 3 = 12,80; 4 = 12,45). Anexo 2º section 3 lists, under Universidad de La Laguna / Grado de experimentalidad 1, 'Máster Universitario en Ciberseguridad e Inteligencia de Datos' BY NAME. So: 15,15 EUR/ECTS x 60 ECTS = 909,00 EUR for the full programme in first enrolment. Add Anexo 1º tarifa tercera: apertura de expediente académico 36,08 EUR + tasa de tramitación de preinscripción en máster 10,00 EUR (deducted from matrícula if you enrol) = 46,08 EUR additional; expedición del título de Máster 218,34 EUR at the end. Seguro escolar is charged only to under-28s. A 3% discount applies to single up-front payment. NON-EU: the decree has NO nationality- or residency-based scale — Canarias is one of the communities that does NOT charge a differentiated non-EU rate, unlike Cataluña or Asturias. This makes ULL among the cheapest official routes in Spain for this candidate. RATE-YEAR CAVEAT: 909 EUR is the 2025-26 figure; the September-2027 intake will be governed by whatever decree is in force for 2027-28, not yet published.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Electrónica y Tecnología Digital Aplicada (METDA)
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Electronics and Applied Digital Technology
institution: Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (ULPGC)
language_of_instruction: Predominantly Spanish. Per the ULPGC Reglamento de Política Lingüística, 5% of credits must be delivered in English: in this plan that is the compulsory 'Scientific Research Methods' (6 ECTS), half of whose credits are taught in English. No statement of English-medium delivery for the rest of the plan. UNCONFIRMED verbatim 'idioma de impartición' field — the ULPGC plan-de-estudios application (www2.ulpgc.es/plan-estudio/5059/actual) redirects to a CAS login and cannot be read.
language_requirement: B1 English accreditation required for admission.
non_eu_surcharge: No. Decreto 177/2022 (Canarias) contains no nationality- or residency-based differentiation. Verified against the full decree text.
entry_requirements: Eligible degrees named: Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática, Ingeniería en Tecnologías de la Telecomunicación, Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería Biomédica, Física Electrónica and related STEM degrees. Required prior competences: programming (C, Python) and software-engineering basics; digital design and FPGA concepts; electronics fundamentals (amplifiers, filters, converters). B1 English.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. 'Ingeniería Informática' is on the named list of eligible degrees. NOTE the caveat: the required prior competences include digital design and FPGA, which a pure software-engineering curriculum may not cover — complementos may then be imposed (see below).
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null in the register). AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme explicitly offers 'training supplements' for students lacking prerequisites in algorithmics, programming or digital design — so a software engineer without FPGA/digital-design background may be assigned complementos. Source: IUMA METDA page.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No reconocimiento de créditos statement located for this title.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. IUMA states preinscripción runs 'in June or the first week of September' each year, through https://www.ulpgc.es/masteres-administracion . Exact 2026-27 dates not captured.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND (the IUMA page renders the coordinator's address as an obfuscated javascript link)
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS. Semester 1, 30 ECTS compulsory: Scientific Research Methods (6), Design and Manufacture of Microelectronic Systems (6), Reconfigurable Computing Systems (6), Advanced Wireless Communications Systems (6), Engineering, Production and Test of Electronic Systems (6). Semester 2 — General itinerary (25 places): four 4.5-ECTS electives from Hardware Acceleration of AI Algorithms, Cybersecurity in Networks, Design of RFIC for Telecommunications, Digital Image Processing Systems, Intelligent Embedded Systems, Advanced Techniques for VLSI Design, Semiconductor Devices (from 2026/27) + TFM (12). Dual itinerary (5 places): two 9-ECTS industrial placements + TFM (12). RELEVANCE CAVEAT FOR PATH C: this is microelectronics/VLSI/RF, NOT audio DSP. The only signal-processing subject is Digital IMAGE Processing. There is no audio, acoustics or speech content.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Instituto Universitario de Microelectrónica Aplicada (IUMA), ULPGC — the master is delivered by the institute.
industry_links: Dual mention: 18 ECTS of industry-based training (5 places).
thesis_or_internship: TFM 12 ECTS; dual itinerary substitutes 18 ECTS of external industrial training for electives.
notes: COST — HONEST GAP. Canarias sets fees by DECRETO 177/2022 (BOC 159, 11/08/2022), extended through 2025-26. Anexo 1º tarifa 1.3, másteres no habilitantes, primera matrícula: exp. 1 = 15,15; exp. 2 = 14,06; exp. 3 = 12,80; exp. 4 = 12,45 EUR/crédito. BUT Anexo 2º of the 2022 decree does NOT list this title — it is new (first taught 2025-26, RUCT verificación 18/07/2025) and the Anexo 2º list is updated annually by the Consejería (art. Disposición about updating Anexo 2º with the titles offered each curso). Its PREDECESSOR, 'Máster Universitario en Electrónica y Telecomunicación Aplicadas', is listed under ULPGC / Grado de experimentalidad 1, i.e. 15,15 EUR/crédito. IF the successor inherits grado 1, the arithmetic would be 15,15 x 60 = 909,00 EUR — but that inheritance is NOT CONFIRMED by any published source, so tuition_per_ects_eur and tuition_total_eur are left at 0 / NOT FOUND rather than invented. A human should open the current ULPGC precios-públicos page (https://www.ulpgc.es/admei/precios-publicos — returns 403 to automated fetching) or the 2026-27 Canarian decree to fix the grade. Additional fees that ARE fixed: apertura de expediente 36,08 EUR + tasa de preinscripción de máster 10,00 EUR; expedición del título de máster 218,34 EUR. NON-EU: no differentiated scale exists in Canarias. ACCESS NOTE: www2.ulpgc.es/plan-estudio/5059/actual is behind a CAS login redirect and could not be read; content here comes from the IUMA (ULPGC institute) pages, which are on the university's own domain.
